# LAHIT Animal Welfare

> LAHIT Animal Welfare is a volunteer-led animal rescue initiative based in Uttarkashi, helping stray and injured animals across Uttarakhand, India.

## About

LAHIT shares rescue stories, lists animals currently available for adoption, coordinates volunteers, receives rescue reports, and publishes updates about animal welfare work. It is a volunteer-led initiative based in Uttarkashi and is not currently a registered NGO or emergency dispatch service. Reports are considered individually based on location, urgency, safety, and available team and veterinary resources.

## Important pages

- [Home](https://lahitanimalwelfaregroup.com/): Mission, impact, rescue reporting, adoption, volunteering, donation, and contact information.
- [Animal rescue in Uttarkashi](https://lahitanimalwelfaregroup.com/uttarkashi/): Local rescue reporting, animal care, adoption, and volunteering information.
- [Animals for adoption](https://lahitanimalwelfaregroup.com/animals/): Rescued animals currently listed for adoption.
- [Rescue stories](https://lahitanimalwelfaregroup.com/rescues/): Before-and-after rescue stories and recovery updates.
- [Field notes and updates](https://lahitanimalwelfaregroup.com/blog/): Articles about rescue work, medical care, feeding drives, adoption, and volunteering.
- [Privacy policy](https://lahitanimalwelfaregroup.com/privacy/): How website information is handled.
- [Terms of service](https://lahitanimalwelfaregroup.com/terms/): Website and submission terms.

## Topics

Animal rescue in Uttarkashi and Uttarakhand, stray dog rescue, cat rescue, injured animal care, pet adoption in Uttarakhand, animal welfare volunteering, feeding drives, sterilization, awareness, and rescue reporting.

## Contact and safety

Use the contact details shown on the website for current enquiries. This website is not an emergency service; for an immediate life-threatening situation, contact the appropriate local emergency, veterinary, or animal-control service first.
